items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I met this boy named [ ] Long and he introduced me to Charlie Creath.

ctx.x: In St. Louis. Um-hum. So, then we played there for awhile and I took a notion I wanted to go to St. Louis. So, I told Patterson, I said, "Well, Patterson, we're going to St. Louis." So, I got -- I said, "All right, you want to go? Come on." Yeah. So, I got Patterson to St. Louis and

left my wife at home, because I always leave her whenever I go somewhere where I don't know where I'm going, in a way of speaking. I would leave her at home, see, because I don't to carry my wife there -- I don't know what I'm going to run into, see. So, I got a place -- a nice place, and soon I ran into her. Then, after I stayed there for awhile, I met this boy named [ ] Long and he introduced me to Charlie Creath. And Charlie Creath in turn asked me, he said, "Are you working?"
